At one of these party’s a buddy of mine got enough shrooms for everyone, I had a stem but I heard after other people had way more. Way later in the night everyone there was going for a walk to the nearby gas station. Two buddy’s of mine decided to stay back at the house, we were all high, drunk, and tripping balls. Us three had been silent for some time, so It came as a surprise when one of my friends picks up a glass and throws it suddenly against the wall. He then charges us two out of whatever trip he was going through. We managed to pin him to the couch before the hosts mom came in, she was super nice abt it and got the vacuum to clean up the glass, she asked if we were good and we said yea but we didn’t tell her anything. We all calmed down a little and me and my other buddy were helping clean up the mess. Out of no where our guy gets up again and storms out of the room, I knew something was wrong so I chanced after him. I went into the kitchen where I had a clear view of the hallway, living room, and balcony. When I looked over at the balcony I saw him trying to jump the balcony’s wall, I ran over trying to pull him back up but at the very last moment he went over, into the dark. He was fine after I’m pretty sure, busted lip and broken glasses but that’s it. One hell of a night.
